items.headline: Claude Managed Agents get dynamic workflows: one agent can now orchestrate many in the cloud
items.summary: In beta, a Managed Agent on Anthropic's servers can write and launch a workflow that fans out to many sub-agents in parallel phases. Up to 64 threads at once, 1,000 agents per run, with a 24-hour default lifetime and no extra charge beyond token and session costs.
items.why: Dynamic workflows close the gap between Claude Code's local orchestration and cloud-hosted agentic work. Developers can now run complex multi-step pipelines on Anthropic's servers without managing their own infrastructure, a step toward production-grade multi-agent systems.

items.headline: Leak: Claude's web interface shows hidden Health and Iggy navigation items
items.summary: TestingCatalog spotted two unreleased navigation entries in Claude's web app, codenamed Arborio (a heart-in-hand icon, possibly health features) and Iggy (a sun icon, purpose unknown). Neither has a confirmed purpose or release date.

items.headline: Leak: a Voice item tagged Preview appears in Claude's web menu
items.summary: TestingCatalog found an extra Voice entry in Claude's web navigation, labelled Preview. Anthropic recently added an optional setting for sharing voice recordings for model training, which may hint at in-house speech models.

items.headline: Leak: OpenAI's pricing page lists an unannounced gpt-rosalind-discovery model
items.summary: The API pricing page now shows gpt-rosalind-discovery alongside gpt-rosalind-research, both at $5/$25 per million input/output tokens. No blog post, help article, or system card exists yet. The name suggests a drug-discovery use case.
